reproducibility.environment: Existing any2bokeh environment; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0; no dependency/allocator/precision changes.
reproducibility.resume: run reuses completed conditions. Incomplete worker directories are preserved and cause a stop; investigate and use an explicit new run path rather than overwrite.
reproducibility.sampling: Six original posterior sample calls: RGB then CoC in each unit, shape16x4x72x128. No explicit sampler generator; global CUDA states agree before/after every matched sample. The original per-call CPU generator0 is preserved and its state is unchanged by this forward.
reproducibility.cache: Five fresh interpreter/model processes; encoder cache absent and latent_cache=None at first call. Subsequent native cache progression recorded without clearing or extra tensor references.
reproducibility.instrumentation: Read-only pre-hooks for UNet/fuser/attention. Process-local observers call original encode/sample exactly once and return original values; restored after run. Metadata/CPU hashes only, no retained GPU tensors.

anomalies_and_recovery.warnings: Existing transformers/diffusers deprecated pytree warnings retained in raw logs; no dependency change.
anomalies_and_recovery.post_run_changes: Only CPU analysis checks, provenance and page metadata were supplemented after inference. No worker rerun or inference logic change.
